newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - SpeedFam gains strength.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - SpeedFam gains strength.

text.p: Shares in SpeedFam International picked up nearly a point in after-hours trading Wednesday after the company posted fiscal fourth quarter earnings above analysts' views, dealers said.

Traders said stock in the processing systems manufacturer traded at 38, up from an unofficial close of 37-1/8, after reporting quarterly earnings of $0.46 per share, flat with the year-ago period. Analysts' polled by First Call predicted fourth quarter earnings of $0.37 per share for the company.
Although the results were posted after the bell, the company's stock rose by 2-1/8 during regular-hours trading.
"There's nothing else that's hot at the moment," a trader said of SpeedFam's ascent.
Kansas utility Western Resources Inc was unchanged in after-hours trading despite the news that it was dropping a $3.5 billion hostile bid for alarm system maker ADT Ltd .
ADT itself also traded in line with a 36-1/8 unofficial close, and Tyco International, which announced it had completed its merger with ADT, did not trade.
During regular-hours trading, however, the Nasdaq composite index soared to a new record high of 1456 after gaining 17 points on the day.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 173,500 from 175,400 on Tuesday. Session two volume fell to 1.3 million from 4.8 million the previous day, it said.
